answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to stake a refundable deposit that is slashed when peers prove misbehavior, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. New agents start with a narrow rate limit and gain trust only through verifiable work history, like quartz forming slowly under pressure. A public reputation mirror lets anyone audit past deals, and a single forged record breaks the pattern the way one false note ruins a sonnet.
